_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md — the plan-and-execute happy path. A clearly-Deliberate debugging task (matches the investigate-failure seed): dispatch.go starts a PlanWorkflow. turn:1 is the PLANNING turn (PlanningMode) — its one scripted response calls propose_plan with 3 checkpoints, no needs_approval, so the approval gate auto-proceeds. plan.seed writes PLAN.md. The PlanWorkflow then runs one checkpoint turn per checkpoint (<turn:1>:cp:1..3), each scripted to call checkpoint_done -> plan.apply_checkpoint_done marks it. All terminal -> finishPlan dispatches RecordSkill (close_reason plan_complete) + signals the coordinator PlanDone. SkillDiscover staged the investigate-failure procedure under the plan_id (owner_id) for the planning turn's prompt + RecordSkill attribution.

message.content: Users report the checkout endpoint returns HTTP 500 intermittently since Tuesday's deploy. Reproduce it, find the root cause, apply a fix, and confirm the reproduction passes.

checkpoints.intent: Isolate the root cause to a specific change or condition
checkpoints.done_when: the offending change is named with evidence

checkpoints.intent: Apply the minimal fix and re-run the reproduction
checkpoints.done_when: the reproduction passes and the cause is understood

arguments.query: checkout 500 NullPointerException payment client since deploy

checkpoint_responses.content: Reproduced: ~1 in 5 requests 500 with a NullPointerException in the payment client.
Root cause: Tuesday's deploy dropped PAYMENT_CLIENT_KEY from the env; the client lazily inits null and only fails once the connection pool cycles — hence intermittent.

arguments.note: PAYMENT_CLIENT_KEY missing from the deploy manifest

checkpoint_responses.content: Restored PAYMENT_CLIENT_KEY in the manifest and added a fail-fast startup check so a missing var can't reach production silently. Reproduction now passes 100/100.
